title: European cultural discoverability in an algorithmic and AI-shaped environment
discussion_signal: The post describes a European Commission study on how platforms, algorithms, metadata, language, and curation determine whether diverse European cultural content becomes visible online. It directly supports the distinction between cultural availability and cultural discoverability.
linked_research_question: How do platform curation, metadata, language, and AI alter who can discover and sustain cultural expression?
limits: Post previews a study rather than reproducing its methods
It is an institutional and professional audience signal
Visibility does not by itself establish audience reach or creator income
